# AutogradCompatibleSpiking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that makes spike-based neural networks compatible with automatic differentiation for gradient-based training. Bridges the gap between neuromorphic hardware and standard deep learning toolchains, accelerating iNEST model development.
